How To Download Pinterest Videos using KlickPin?

What KlickPin does

KlickPin processes publicly accessible Pinterest links and shows the media made available for that link. Depending on the source, results may include videos, images, GIFs, stories, carousels, or available items from supported boards and profiles. You do not need to provide Pinterest login credentials.

The steps below explain how to download available Pinterest videos, images, and GIFs from the mobile app or a desktop browser.

Steps to Download from Mobile App:

  1. Open the Pinterest App and select the video, image, or GIF you want to download.
  2. Tap on the ••• icon at the top right corner of the Pinterest app. If you are using the latest version, tap on the ••• icon at the bottom right corner of the app. After tapping the ••• icon, tap on the Copy Link option.
  3. Paste the video URL in the Download Input Box on the KlickPin website, and tap on the Download button.
  4. You will see a preview of your download file. Tap on the Download button just below it.
  5. The Pinterest video, image, or GIF will be downloaded to your device.

Click 3 Dots

Click Copy Link

URL has been Copied

Steps to Download from Desktop:

  1. Open the Pinterest website on your browser and select the video, image, or GIF you want to download.
  2. Copy the Pinterest video URL from the browser
  3. Paste the URL in the box and press download.
  4. The video will be available for download.
  5. Drag the video file from the Downloads folder on your computer to your desired location.

What works / what does not

Pinterest links and media that KlickPin can and cannot process
What works What does not work
  • Public Pinterest Pin and pin.it links
  • Public Pinterest Ideas and Answers pages
  • Public boards and profiles, up to 50 available Pins per request
  • Videos, images, GIFs, stories, carousels, and available source resolutions, including HD, 2K, and 4K when provided by Pinterest
  • Private, login-only, restricted, deleted, or unavailable content
  • Pinterest invitation and board-collaboration links
  • Bypassing Pinterest access controls or permissions
  • Creating or upscaling a resolution that is not available from the Pinterest source

Quality note: KlickPin supports HD, 2K, and 4K when Pinterest provides those source files. It returns the available source quality as provided, does not manufacture or upscale media, and results can differ between Pins.


Does KlickPin Work on Mobile?

KlickPin is designed to work in modern mobile and desktop browsers, including:

  • Android users (you can even install the APK)
  • iOS/iPhone users - including saving to camera roll
  • Desktop users (great for those who edit or manage content)

Whether you're searching for a Pinterest video downloader app, a Chrome extension, or just a fast website - KlickPin works from any browser.


What Else Can You Download?

Aside from standard Pinterest videos, KlickPin also helps you download:

  • Pinterest reels and short videos
  • Pinterest images
  • GIFs posted as animated pins
  • Stories and Idea Pins (multi-step tutorials or slideshows)
  • Pinterest carousels with multiple images or videos
  • Pinterest Ideas pages with images and videos from topic collections
  • Pinterest Answers pages with images and videos from answer collections
  • Pinterest profiles and Pinterest boards
  • Multiple pin share links from Pinterest

For Pinterest profiles and boards, KlickPin can collect up to 50 available pins per request. These pins may include videos, GIFs, images, stories, or carousels when available.


Is KlickPin Safe to Use?

KlickPin is designed to process public Pinterest URLs without asking for your Pinterest username or password. As with any online download service, use only URLs and media you are permitted to download, and keep your browser and device security up to date.

  • KlickPin does not require Pinterest login credentials.
  • It works through your browser; you do not need to give KlickPin access to your Pinterest account.
  • Private and restricted content, including login-only, invitation, and deleted content, is not supported.

Responsible use and creator rights

Publicly accessible content is not automatically copyright-free or public domain. Download only content you own or are authorized or legally permitted to save. KlickPin does not grant permission to reuse, republish, or commercially exploit downloaded media. Pinterest states that people retain rights to the content they post and provides a process for copyright complaints. Read the Pinterest Terms of Service and Pinterest Copyright Policy. KlickPin is not affiliated with Pinterest.

Privacy and service data

To provide, secure, measure, and improve the service and display ads, KlickPin uses Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Google advertising and consent services, and normal server logs. Depending on your consent and settings, these services may process page views, traffic sources, approximate location, IP address and security-request information, browser and device details, response status, ad interactions, and masked page-interaction data such as clicks, scrolling, and navigation. The Pinterest URL you submit is processed to generate results. It is not included in KlickPin's custom analytics event, and form inputs are masked in Clarity recordings. KlickPin also records aggregate download-result details such as media type, Pinterest URL category, item count, media-source category, and collection type. Read our Privacy Policy for more information.

Questions & Answers !!

Can I download videos from Pinterest?

Yes, when the video is available through a publicly accessible Pinterest URL. Copy the URL, paste it in the form above, and click Download to see the available result.

How to download Pinterest videos?

  1. Copy the public Pinterest URL.
  2. Paste it into the KlickPin downloader and select Download.
  3. Choose an available result and save it with your browser.

How can I download images from Pinterest?

To download images from Pinterest, follow the same steps as for videos. Copy the image URL, paste it into the form, and click Download. The image will be saved to your device.

Can I download GIFs from Pinterest?

Yes, KlickPin supports downloading GIFs from Pinterest. Copy the GIF URL, paste it in the form above, and click the Download button to save the GIF to your device.

Where are files saved after being downloaded?

Downloaded files are typically saved in the "Downloads" folder on your device. You can check your browser's download history by pressing CTRL+J on your keyboard.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does the Pinterest URL need to be public?

Yes. KlickPin processes publicly accessible Pinterest URLs. Private, login-only, restricted, deleted, and unavailable content cannot be accessed.

Can I download Pinterest boards and profiles?

Yes. KlickPin supports publicly accessible Pinterest board and profile URLs and can collect up to 50 available Pins per request. A larger board or profile will not be downloaded in its entirety in one request.

Can KlickPin process private or invitation URLs?

No. Private, restricted, login-only, and Pinterest invitation or board-collaboration URLs are not supported. KlickPin does not bypass access controls or permissions.

What quality and formats are available?

KlickPin supports HD, 2K, and 4K when Pinterest provides those source files. It returns the available format and resolution as provided by the public Pinterest source, does not manufacture or upscale media, and results can differ between Pins.

Does KlickPin store downloaded files?

KlickPin does not maintain a permanent user-media library or ask users to upload files. A submitted public Pinterest URL is processed to locate available media, and delivery providers or network caches may temporarily handle responses. Normal technical, security, analytics, and aggregate result data is processed as described in the Privacy Policy.

Are KlickPin browser extensions available?

Yes. KlickPin browser extensions are available for Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Microsoft Edge.

What am I allowed to download and reuse?

Download only publicly accessible media that you own or are authorized or legally permitted to save. Public availability does not make content copyright-free or public domain, and KlickPin does not grant permission to reuse, republish, or commercially exploit downloaded media. See the Terms of Service.
